verdict.rationale: Productboard's official MCP server lets coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor read product specs directly and "start building off a product specification" ("Pull a spec, talk through the plan with your agent, and build"). Delivery integrations also push development-ready, prioritized features into GitHub issues, Jira and Azure DevOps, and the vendor says only fully-validated features are sent into delivery. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how a spec's approval status gates what developers can pull, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
